title: Kernel of a Vandermonde matrix
statement: Let $K$ be a field, let $k$ be a natural number, and let $\alpha_1,\ldots,\alpha_k$ be pairwise distinct elements of $K$. If a vector $v\in K^k$ is in the kernel of the Vandermonde matrix formed from these elements, then $v=0$.
hypotheses_covered: The entries of $\alpha$ are pairwise distinct
The Vandermonde matrix formed from $\alpha$ sends $v$ to zero
